Game Idea: Gun Game: Arsenal Wars

Genre: First-Person Shooter (FPS)

Description

Gun Game: Arsenal Wars is a fast-paced Roblox shooter where every elimination upgrades your weapon. Players race through an arsenal of guns, from simple pistols to powerful sniper rifles and explosive launchers. The first player to get a kill with every weapon wins the match.

Unlike a traditional shooter, players must constantly adapt because each new weapon has different strengths and weaknesses.

Gameplay

8-20 players per match. 

Every elimination gives you the next weapon. 

Getting eliminated doesn't reset your progress. 

The final weapon is a Golden Knife. Eliminate one player with it to win. 

Game Modes

🔥 Classic Gun Game

Progress through every weapon in order.

💥 Team Gun Game

Work with your team to unlock weapons together.

⚡ Random Weapons

Everyone receives a random weapon every 20 seconds.

🎯 Snipers Only

Long-range combat with sniper rifles.

👑 Boss Round

One player becomes a powerful boss with extra health while everyone else works together to defeat them.

Maps

Factory - Conveyor belts, warehouses, and rooftops. 

Desert Base - Military outpost with open sightlines. 

Downtown - Streets, shops, and apartment buildings. 

Space Station - Low-gravity combat and futuristic corridors. 

Castle Siege - Medieval castle mixed with modern weapons. 

Weapons

Players progress through weapons like:

Pistol 

Revolver 

SMG 

Shotgun 

Assault Rifle 

Burst Rifle 

LMG 

Sniper Rifle 

Crossbow 

Rocket Launcher 

Golden Knife 

Progression

Earn:

XP 

Coins 

Daily rewards 

Achievement badges 

Unlock:

Weapon skins 

Character outfits 

Kill effects 

Emotes 

Victory animations 

Player titles 

Features

Daily missions 

Seasonal battle pass 

Ranked mode with skill-based matchmaking 

Private servers 

Spectator mode 

Kill streak announcements 

Match voting for the next map and game mode 

Visual Style

The game uses a colorful, slightly stylized look with smooth animations and clear weapon effects, making it easy to follow the action while still feeling exciting.

Why Players Will Enjoy It

The constant weapon changes keep every match fresh and reward players who can adapt to different playstyles. Quick matches, varied maps, cosmetic rewards, and multiple game modes encourage players to keep coming back and improve their skills.

answers.ask: Which of the five maps should be built first, and should the rest be separate builds?
answers.answer: Build Factory first; its warehouses, conveyors, and rooftops fit the fast-paced Gun Game combat well. The other maps should be separate builds added later.

answers.ask: 8-20 players is a wide range - should the map be sized for 8 or for 20?
answers.answer: Size the first map for 8 players so the initial build stays tight, readable, and consistently active.

answers.ask: Gun game is usually a tight free-for-all arena rather than two-team lanes. Should the map be symmetric with opposing bases, or a loop with spawns spread around it?
answers.answer: Use a compact loop with spawns spread around it, since Classic Gun Game is a free-for-all arena rather than opposing-team lanes.
